record_title: Four-step Sparre-Andersen persistence detects a pure fourth-order interaction
provenance: Exact four-step persistence formula for fair 3-wise independent signs with iid non-atomic positive amplitudes of support ratio below two, identifying the sole fourth-order sign interaction.
limitations: Finite four-step horizon; independent sign-amplitude representation with amplitude support [a,b] satisfying b<2a; no characterization of all real-valued 3-wise independent increment laws or asymptotic persistence. Parity conditioning and Walsh-Fourier limited-independence constructions are classical and are not claimed as new. Older dependent-fluctuation literature leaves residual priority uncertainty.
